finding: The 12-question exercise reads the original 15-question rows and selects up to 12 based on the dimension field, then fills by original order. It is not a separate rephrased corpus.
method: Compare the 12-question selection to the complete 15-question list per Sujet
Retain all 15 question positions and original four-column presentation
Prioritize semantic relevance, naturally diverse question forms, appropriate past/present/future/conditional/subjunctive and vous/tu consistency
Retain approved originals when variation would be artificial
Preserve changed original text with originalFr for audit and progress isolation
tracking: Every Sujet stores fusion3D.version=2 and an edit list. Prior optimized replacements remain tagged with originalFr.
qualification: Three-dimensional diagnosis is a human-guided editorial review, not an official C1 scoring rubric. Questions are not forced into a fixed distribution of interrogatives or tenses.
